title: Topic 6
japanese_text: 子どもの頃、「ドラえもん」が掲載されている<u>分厚い</u>月<u>刊</u>漫画雑誌が<u>刊行されて</u>いた。おもちゃの<u>付録</u>も魅力的だった。発売日には、お小遣いを<u>握り締めて</u>、本屋に走ったものだ。
english_translation: When I was a child, there was a thick manga publication, released monthly, that featured the character Doraemon. The toy supplement was also very appealing to me. On the day it was released, I would run to the bookstore grasping my allowance in hand.
